description: This script detects unresolved merge conflict markers in tracked files within a git repository. It provides functions to list files, identify conflict marker lines, and report violations, with an executable main function that outputs conflicts and exits with an error code if issues are found.

methods.name: isBinaryBuffer
methods.description: Checks if the provided buffer contains binary data by looking for null bytes.

methods.name: findConflictMarkerLines
methods.description: Identifies lines in the content string that contain git conflict markers and returns their line numbers.

methods.name: listTrackedFiles
methods.description: Lists all tracked files in the git repository, returning their full paths.

methods.name: findConflictMarkersInFiles
methods.description: Checks a list of files for conflict markers and returns details about violations per file.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that runs the conflict marker detection across tracked files and outputs the results, setting the process exit code accordingly.
